title: Packing the Study
author: Luna Engine
opening_text: The keeper can hold your bag while you work. Pack for the journey, then carry your bag into the garden and use it to finish.
help_text: Try examine, open, close, look in, take, put, give, and ask. Hints are available for the door.
unknown_command_text: I couldn't match that command. Try help, or use a visible object's name.

endings.name: Ready to travel
endings.text: Everything is packed. You step into the garden, ready for the journey.
